original_hook: 📰 CoinDesk reports stablecoin wallets are increasingly replacing traditional checking accounts for consumer cash. Yet $BTC remains tightly compressed around $77,300. Source: Stablecoin wallets challenge traditional bank accounts as main consumer money hub Here is the mechanical lag: capital moving on-chain isn't immediately chasing spot risk. While Wall Street ETF wrappers shed $449M over three days following a warm +0.3% Core CPI print, that liquidity isn't returning to traditional banks. It is sitting in yield-bearing stablecoin rails as structural dry powder. The risk. If persistent inflation forces actual fiat redemptions out of top stablecoin issuers, the buffer dissolves. But if stablecoin market cap holds firm while ETF outflows stall, purchasing power is simply coiling on-chain. Bullish, bearish, or wait?
